featured_reviews.name: Swapna Thakur
featured_reviews.review_text:
Shenvi School Of Dance is undoubtedly the best dance class with positive vibes in Khar area for children. My child started attending classes here since last June and the progress he has made since then is truly incredible. Not only has his dance technique improved significantly, but his confidence, discipline and creativity have blossomed too.
The instructors are competent, patient, encouraging and have a genuine passion for teaching. They cultivate a supportive and enjoyable learning environment where children feel comfortable expressing themselves while developing their skills. The personalized attention and engaging approach of Kiran Sir has made a noticeable difference in my child's dance journey. He is an amazing person and the best mentor. My child looks forward to every class and is excited to show off his new moves.
This dance studio is highly recommended for parents seeking quality dance training and a wonderful & enriching experience for their child's overall development.

featured_reviews.name: sukhminder madan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent studio  of dance at Khar West with Super choreographer Kiran and his team of Ms Varsha and others.
They helped us plan and execute the entire musical workshop on my wife 60th birthday.with more than 60 guests.
Really impressed by their talent and professionalism. Thanx a lot.🙏🙏🙏Sukhminder S Madan.

featured_reviews.name: Namrata Dalmia
featured_reviews.review_text:
1.	Versatility in Dance Forms – My daughter has been introduced to multiple styles, each taught with precision and flair. From classical grace to contemporary grooves, the studio nurtures a true love for all forms of dance.
2.	Choreography Magic – I was amazed to see her perform a three-minute choreography with confidence and polish, achieved in just four sessions! The instructors’ ability to break down complex steps into simple, joyful learning is nothing short of brilliance.
3.	World-Class Faculty – The teachers are not only masters of their craft but also patient, inspiring mentors. Their passion radiates in every class and makes the students shine.
4.	Collaborative Spirit – Learning alongside such fantastic groups has been an experience of teamwork, rhythm, and harmony. The studio creates a supportive environment where children uplift one another while growing together.
5.	Beyond Just Dance – This isn’t only about perfecting steps; it’s about discipline, creativity, confidence, and the joy of expression. The studio truly builds performers for both stage and life.

✨ In short: An extraordinary dance journey where learning feels like art in motion. Highly recommended for every parent who wants their child to experience the language of dance in its finest form!

featured_reviews.name: Sarika Periwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Shenvi School of Dance is an excellent choice for dance training. My daughter has been a part of this institution for over a year now, and here's what makes it stand high above other dance classes in my opinion....
1. The founders, Kiran Shenvi and his wife Varsha are deeply involved with the minutest details of how the school is run.
2. This is a proper "school" that teaches various forms of dance. It has a curriculum with levels, and children get promoted to higher levels as they learn the techniques and skills. It's not just about picking a song and dancing to it (though that's a part of it, of course), it's about learning various advanced dance techniques through every dance session, and then progressing to the next level.
3. Kiran Shenvi Sir is the heart and soul of the institution, and his passion for dance trickles down to the entire team of teachers. He personally teaches many classes, and is usually around to supervise other classes conducted by his team.
4. The entire team is very friendly and welcoming. It feels like home for the kids. They just love going to class.
5. The setup is preferable to other celebrity dance schools with branches all over, where it's highly unlikely you'll ever get to learn under the founding teacher.
6. Their studio is newly renovated with a wonderful ambience that makes you wanna dance.
7. My daughter's dance skills have greatly improved.
Overall, when I was looking for dance classes for my daughter over a year back and took some trials in my area, Shenvi School of Dance really stood out. And today, after a year, we're really happy we chose this school.

featured_reviews.name: Kanika Ahuja
featured_reviews.review_text:
My daughter Krrisha started learning Dance with the Shenvi Team a couple of years ago. She's received a lot of support and positive encouragement from them. My daughter is always super excited to attend her dance class. The impact has always been positive and the increase of confidence and focus has improved so much!
Thanks a ton Shenvi team❤️❤️❤️
A must must recommendation!!☺️

featured_reviews.name: Akanksha Mathur
featured_reviews.review_text:
Shenvi School of Dance is One of the best schools I have come across that showcases their dedication to their students through their teachings and support. The SSD team creates an atmosphere of fun learning, Discipline and creativity along with following your passion.  My association with them has been mostly off stage and it has been truly an experience to watch them perform and learn nuances of the art they teach and the community they have created.
If you want to learn Contemporary, Modern Dancing, Shenvi School of Dance is the place to be. . Without a doubt!!!

featured_reviews.name: Ruchita Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: Shenvi School of Dance has been a wonderful experience for both my daughter and me . It is a school of dance that has a fair balance technique, warm ups, dancing and play. The Teachers are very warm and caring...at the same time make the children better their skills of dancing each day one step at a time...we have had a very fulfilling experience...Thank you so much...❤️🙏

featured_reviews.name: Forum Surti
featured_reviews.review_text:
Honestly, I can’t say enough good things about Shenvi School of Dance. My daughter’s been going here for Jazzhop and Contemporary, and what I’ve seen in just a short span is nothing short of amazing. It's not just about dance steps or technique—this school genuinely brings out the best in each child.
What really sets it apart is the ethos behind it all. There’s a deep-rooted belief here that every child has something special within them, and the focus isn’t on who’s the flashiest or the fastest—it’s on helping each one grow at their own pace, in their own way. They don’t just teach movement—they nurture confidence, individuality, and joy.
Kiran Shenvi, the founder, is the real heart and soul behind it. His vision goes way beyond just skill or talent. He sees dance as a way for kids to express themselves, to grow emotionally and mentally, not just physically. He’s not interested in cookie-cutter dancers— he wants each child to shine in their light. And you can feel that energy the moment you walk into the studio.
There’s no pressure, no competition, just pure encouragement and passion. My daughter comes out of every class beaming—more confident, more free, and more in love with dance than ever before.
Shenvi School of Dance isn’t just a place to learn steps. It’s a space where kids find their voice, their rhythm, and their strength. Couldn’t ask for more and couldn’t be more grateful to have found SSD!

featured_reviews.review_text: I have never danced in my Life.. Always wanted to dance at social occasions/ gatherings.. I realised I have two left feet.. Choreography was too fast to learn.. Found DANCE CENTRAL  where dance is thought in a systematic manner. Also as part of curriculum you are taught musicality, dancing etiquette’s etc.. featured_reviews.name: Mamta Rupani
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is a perfect dance school to learn latin dance form. I did level 1 of Salsa here.. it was a beautiful experience. Getting the opportunity to learn from Vineet Sir in itself is a privilege. He is a fantastic teacher and person who has extensive knowledge and experience when it comes to salsa. He has a unique way of teaching that has a lasting impression. Each class that I attended, I not just learnt new things but also was able to register it effectively and can apply certain things to life in general.

Other students there were kind and it was a delight dancing with them. Higher level salsa students also were polite and gave great insights on Salsa.

I love Vineet Sir's dedication to training students seriously with every detail for a wholesome understanding.

If anyone reading this is looking to learn what Salsa actually is. Join Dance Central and learn from the best :)

I too joined here through a friend's recommendation. This experience only exceeded my expectations ✨

Thank you ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Vincent Kelley
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been taking salsa and bachata classes with Vineet for over a year and a half. His teaching method is unique and ensures that the student acquires a strong foundation in Latin dance fundamentals. Vineet’s method is different from the random mix and match approach found in many other dance classes. Instead, he teaches in a methodical and integrated manner with an eye toward the long-term progress of the student. I can’t recommend Vineet’s salsa and bachata classes in Mumbai highly enough!

featured_reviews.name: Manthan Patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had an amazing experience with the dance sessions!
The balance between theory, practicals, counts, and FCP was absolutely on point, making the learning process smooth and enjoyable.

Initially, we thought it might be a one-sided session, but Vineet made it highly interactive and engaging, which kept us motivated throughout.
The classes were incredibly helpful, and we’d love to join again in the future!

featured_reviews.name: Sakshi
featured_reviews.review_text: Great classes by Vineet for Salsa and Bachata. His approach is very methodical and fun. We had people ranging from ages 16-60 in our class and he created a space for all of us to learn in an engaging way. Best vibes ✨️

featured_reviews.name: Dhrumi Gala
featured_reviews.review_text:
Vineet I'm forever grateful for introducing me to the world of dance! You helped me discover a new sense of rhythm and stability I never knew I needed. What started as a
'let's try it for a month' experiment turned into a 2-year journey of self-expression and growth! Thank you for believing in me and sparking this passion within!

featured_reviews.name: Soham Bagchi
featured_reviews.review_text:
The passion of Vineet shines through. I am a person who has two left feet and is incapable of moving, that too gracefully.

This is what I believed, the hardest part was getting in the door, and once I did, Vineet and his methods of teaching have ensured that I am hooked. I see learning and development happen every single class and noticeable progression.

The beauty lies in the journey and the joy we have while traveling this journey together.

Love the good vibes from Vineet, the rest of the students in the class and positive, inclusive learning environment created.

When learning is fun, that's when growth happens. On a purposeful journey of growth with Dance Central.

featured_reviews.name: Harshil Vora
featured_reviews.review_text: I've attended a lot of dance classes in the past and I love learning new skills all the time. So learning dance isn't new for me. Or so I thought, until I started learning at Dance Central with Vineet! In the best possible way, I've realised there is so much depth and technique to Dance that requires not just a great dancer, but an incredible teacher, to be able to learn. And yet that is only a fraction of who Vineet is. The quality of education is mindfully balanced with fun, humour and authenticity! There is such detailed structure to each class, each conversation. It feels like your mind has to move faster than your feet, and it does! This class completely changed my perspective on learning dance and set a whole new benchmark for any dance form I learn next. Super grateful to have been able to learn here and will definitely continue into every further level they have! Highly, highly, highly recommended!

featured_reviews.review_text:
I still remember the day I went for a trial class, recommended by a friend—never knowing it would become such a big part of my life. I never imagined doing Zumba, but I’m so glad I showed up and stuck around. Looking back, it’s one of the best decisions I’ve ever made!

Now, after almost two years with RHF, Zumba is more than just a workout—it’s my happy place! . This class not only helped me stay active but have truly lifted my spirit.

Fitness has become a huge part of my life, and it’s all thanks to Priya!  Not just Zumba—I’ve also grown to appreciate strength training. Although it’s not something I naturally love to do, but the push to do better, to challenge myself, and to step out of my comfort zone has helped me tremendously.

featured_reviews.name: Shikha Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: Alayna absolutely loves going to this Happy Feet class. Started with Ms. Purvis love to amazing dance skills learnt in the class. Boosted her confidence and she has picked up so many dance steps and choreography with absolute ease !!

featured_reviews.review_text:
The last three weeks have been truly amazing! Even in this short span, we’ve seen small but definite progress in Xael. She’s becoming more confident, and most importantly, she absolutely loves the class.

A special thank you to Shruti — her energy, patience, and the way she connects with the kids is truly wonderful. Xael speaks so fondly of her, and we can clearly see that she feels encouraged and excited to learn every time.

The videos shared to us parents have been such a joy to watch — they beautifully capture her progress and enthusiasm. We couldn’t be happier!

We would love to continue and are really excited to see how far this journey could take her. Thank you for creating such a nurturing and inspiring space.
Sagar & Anju

Split Sole believes the combination of technique work and stylized movement can bring out the quality of a professional dancer in one, and therefore introduced Jazz Funk to the city for the very first time in 2009. Dance styles like Contemporary & Hip Hop are also taught at our studios across the city. At the academy, awaits a super fun, passionate and dedicated team of artists and teachers to make your dance journey a memorable one!

Elvis on the other hand , is also renowned for World Salsa Championship Professional Solo category Winner 🏆 and World House Championship 🏆 trophy too under his name. And this list goes on and on.

One must come to learn and experience himself what makes an International Champion who he/she is. Word's fall short of how dedicated and disciplined Elvis & Namrata are both in their personal as well as professional life. Precision Teaching, World class techniques, Great Instructions, Personal feedback student wise , focused on students growth -- these are the great qualities one can aim for learning any Dance form. In a nutshell, it's 10 on 10.

featured_reviews.name: Rashmi Oak
featured_reviews.review_text: I came to know about Sanjana’s classes through Instagram and I was so happy to finally have found someone who teaches belly dancing. So far our classes have been taken by Sanjana and Antra. Even though i attend zoom classes, I get the exact same vibe of in person learning. So far I have enjoyed all my 13 classes and I am excited to learn more and more from them. Both of them are excellent instructors and they do have different style of teaching and I equally enjoy learning from both of them. The classes have quite a bit of work with variations of basic steps and practicing them over and over again. It doesn’t matter whether you have a big or a flat belly, you can dance or not, you are thin or big, if you are sincere about the dance form and the learning process, this is THE place for you. Kudos to Sanjana for conducting these sessions👏.

The instructors Samuel (Sam) & Prekshaa (Pepa) are the the most attentive, fun, quirky teachers you'll find. Learning from them will make you forget you ever had two left feet :p. Not to mention what a great pair of dancers they are!
A serious recommendation from me to attend their Workshops, and their Social Dance nights for a fun time in town.

featured_reviews.name: Kaushik Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had no idea of the dance form, and had attended multiple demos and workshops of other forms to understand which would be my Jam. Though I am not a Jazz or blues person, what made it more appealing to me are rather the instructors Sam and Preksha, who would be more of friends with you during the class rather than instructors, who would attend to each of the participants without letting the rest of the participants feel left out, and the community of Lindyhop that they have built just because of that trait! Whenever Socials happen, it's not a Hi/Hello but a gathering of friends getting back again! The dance form, is fun, and comes with another subset of Blues dance form, which adds to the variety of songs you can dance to. All in all, I am happy to have ever been offered this experience of being a part of this.
Hope all the very best to both Sam and Preksha and to the Lindy community!

If you’re thinking about trying something new, this is definitely the class to take!

featured_reviews.review_text:
We had Kunal Jessani as the emcee for our daughter’s wedding at Raddison Lonavala, and he was absolutely fantastic!💯

From the Haldi Carnival, where he kept everyone engaged with fun games, dancing, and the perfect build-up to the haldi, to the Sangeet, where he had the entire crowd grooving (especially to Oh Ho Oh Ho 🔥), his energy never dipped for a second.

The Baraat was on another level altogether — Kunal brought unmatched energy, hype, and coordination, making it truly unforgettable. He was pumped, lively, and completely in sync with the crowd throughout all the events.

If you’re looking for an emcee who can elevate the vibe, keep guests involved, and bring infectious energy to every moment, Kunal Jessani is the one. Highly recommend!✨

featured_reviews.name: Shiwali Chaudhari
featured_reviews.review_text: Kunal is a total rockstar! From the moment he confirmed, I knew our Haldi was going to be the highlight of the wedding, and he absolutely delivered. He planned and executed every detail better than I could have imagined. The Bollywood themes were a massive hit, and he even choreographed a special dance with my family! He kept everyone entertained and engaged throughout the Sangeet, and a month later, our guests are still raving about how much fun they had. If you want an emcee who treats your wedding like their own, Kunal is your guy!

featured_reviews.name: Sarah Fellay
featured_reviews.review_text: Kunal Jessani did an incredible job as our wedding choreographer and anchor! My family and friends were attending their first Indian wedding and were very nervous about their sangeet performance. He was amazing at putting together remixes that had special meaning for us, putting everyone at ease, making sure everyone had a blast, and creating an amazing atmosphere at the wedding. Received so much feedback from our guests about our amazing wedding anchor - you can't go wrong with him!

featured_reviews.name: Sonia Vora
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kunal is the perfect host and choreographer. Many guests after our wedding commented on Kunal’s amazing energy as an MC for three of our events and his and his teams great energy and helpfulness as choreographers (shout out to Utaara and Himanshu for being so helpful and amazing in Bangalore and Calcutta).

Kunal literally saved the day for multiple of our events where we didn’t have a plan for how to engage the audience and ensured everyone had a great time from American friends to uncle.

As a former dancer myself, I love how clear and professional he is as a choreographer where he effortlessly handled teaching dances over zoom and in person to over 40 of our friends and family in the Us / Europe as well. His choreography strikes the right balance of creative / challenging and easy depending on the group. We chose Kunal even though he didn’t live in our city because we had a great experience with him as a guest at another friends wedding - and we are so happy with the choice as he is super helpful, kind, professional and fun!

featured_reviews.name: Fellay T
featured_reviews.review_text: Kunal designed a choreography based on the music we chose. Although it was partly in French, he was able to adapt it to our group (mainly foreigners, different ages, family and friends). Always available to answer our questions, always positive, before and during and after the rehearsal. Then throughout the wedding, he was full of positive and vibrant energy, galvanizing everybody with good mood, joy, humanity, love of music and dance . Extremely professional at the same time. Thank you so much Kunal.

featured_reviews.name: Kunal Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: Kunal emcees and did dance choreography for our wedding. I would say without exaggeration that he made our wedding what it was. Incredible energy, creativity and patience. KJ was a hit with all of our guests and friends. If you are thinking of a choreo or emcee, you cannot find a better person - don’t think twice.

featured_reviews.name: SIMONI RATHOD
featured_reviews.review_text: It’s was a pleasure to have Kunal as our wedding host. He kept the crowds energy at the highest level at all time. He didn’t just host he also brought my bridal entry vision to life by guiding me with all the technicals. I strongly recommend having Kunal Jessani as your host for the wedding.

featured_reviews.name: Sejal
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had an amazing experience with Kunal as the emcee for my daughter’s birthday party! He brought so much energy and fun to the event, engaging both kids and adults in a variety of games that kept everyone entertained throughout the day. His ability to keep the party lively and interactive was fantastic, and his presence on the mic added a great vibe to the celebration.

Kunal was professional, friendly, and knew exactly how to manage the crowd, making sure every guest felt included. Whether it was organizing games for the little ones or getting the adults involved, he handled it all seamlessly, ensuring there was never a dull moment. He was alert and smiling and this was highlighted by a lot of the guest days after the party was over.

If you’re looking for someone who can bring excitement and keep your event running smoothly, I highly recommend him for any party or gathering!

featured_reviews.name: Arnabh Banerjee
featured_reviews.review_text:
LITfit Studio is less of a studio more like a Sanctuary for people looking for overall wellness through fitness offering various courses, nestled within the chaos and hustle of Bandra, conviniently located for those who wish to disconnect and sweat it out.
Kudos to Anamika and her team for their dedication and rigour.

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Sarkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Anamika and the team are fantastic at providing a suite of fitness classes for all ages, workout styles (from pilates to bolly dance to boxing), and abilities. Great studio space for shoots as well.

featured_reviews.name: Manan Pajwani
featured_reviews.review_text: Offers top-notch dance instruction with talented and patient instructors. The studio is clean and welcoming, with a great variety of classes for all skill levels. The supportive community and focus on technique make it a standout choice. Highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Gauravi Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: If you're looking for a fitness and dance studio that brings both high energy and a welcoming atmosphere, look no further than Lit Fit Dance & Fitness Studio! From the moment you step through the door, you’re greeted with an infectious enthusiasm that sets the tone for an invigorating workout experience.

featured_reviews.name: Nikitha Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text: What got my attention to the Litfit studio was the space and the perfect location!! A buffet full of classes under the guidance of young, highly energetic and professional instructors!! Would highly recommend this place as you get to choose from a variety of classes based on your workout preference and schedule!!

featured_reviews.name: Muskan Arya
featured_reviews.review_text: Lit and Fit Dance and Fitness is amazing! The energy is infectious, and the instructors keep it fun and motivating. It's the best way to work out and have a blast

featured_reviews.name: Bella Mulchandani
featured_reviews.review_text: Perfect mix of various classes which truly give results, trained and expert instructors, well priced, super well maintained and  awesome vibe . Must try . Shoutout to the founder Anamika - she’s really great at what she does .. must try her classes .

featured_reviews.name: payal jashnani
featured_reviews.review_text: The studio offers a variety of classes to choose from & I personally loved the Spinning session with Anamika. Definitely a Lit & Fit workout & that to the hub of Bandra West!❤️❤️

featured_reviews.name: Areea Parswani
featured_reviews.review_text: Love TRDC. Such inspiring teachers and students feels like home!

featured_reviews.name: nirvana sawhney
featured_reviews.review_text: The teachers are lovely. They are warm and passionate about dance and very helpful. They make it easy to underatand and pay attention to form. I have taken Jazz and Tap classes and have seen the growth in my performance and confidence. I especially enjoyed participating in the annual dance showcase.

featured_reviews.name: Shreya Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: I absolutely love their classes! They have a very different way of teaching, by using imagination, by letting you be yourself but at the same time teaching you the proper techniques. I love all their classes Jazz, Contemporary and Ballet. I wouldn't ever be able to choose between the three. Jazz brings out a very stylish me but the feeling I get in Contemporary is amazing and Ballet is helping me become a much stronger dancer. I would give all the credit to them for making me the dancer I am today. :D <3

featured_reviews.name: Vidula Kumtha
featured_reviews.review_text:
TR Dance company in Bandra is an awesome place to learn dance! All dance teachers are super friendly ,involved and you’ll get the attention you need. I have got enrolled here for my 6yr old daughter and she is enjoying her classes thoroughly.
Learning here is super fun and enriching  too at the same time.

featured_reviews.name: Juhi Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ballet is a technical style but they way they teach makes it a lot of fun and you also learn a lot, it has made me a much stronger dancer and when it comes to their teaching I have loved the feeling they have brought in me. It made me feel so free and at the same time I learnt so much about Contemporary and Jazz. Jazz brings about a lot of confidence in you as with the learning you have to bring a lot of style to the table.
I have had the best of times with them and I have loved each and every moment there.

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Vora
featured_reviews.review_text: The best dance class I have been too and I recommend everyone who is passionate and love dancing should join in. Amazing teachers,Good environment and a best place to love and enjoy dance.Fresh routines,high energy classes and whole & whole good and impactful workout session. It is a class where teacher care and give personal feedback..TRDC rocks!!!

featured_reviews.name: nicole padival
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am very fortunate to have found TRDC❤️ Simply put, classes here make me happy! The teachers are inspiring, motivating and pay attention to the tiniest detail. They've corrected my posture and made me comfortable in my own skin- which are absolute bonuses when I think of the fabulous dancer I'm becoming😁
Soooo worth it and loads of fun, I wish they had class everyday!

featured_reviews.name: Deanne Fernandez
featured_reviews.review_text: I honestly love TR dance company . They are like family to me. The teachers are one of a kind , very caring and always spreading good and positive energy.  The routines are amazing. Trdc is the best place to be .😄

featured_reviews.name: rodman dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been coming to RaSa now for well over year… and over the year it’s has become more than just steps and learning a dance form… it’s a happy place, a fun place, a wonderful place where you come to learn to dance but yet get more than that… you get bonds of friendship and camaraderie which you rarely find outside… you get to learn two really beautiful souls who are not just teaching you… but pouring their love and passion in every step and every move… making even the most intricate of combinations learnable and smooth … giving you the skills to but just dance but dance socially and confidently… that’s the beauty of Sangeeta and Raoul … that’s the goodness of RaSa…slowly nudging you out of your shell… and changing your two left feet to just a single one that moves to rhythm… grateful to these beautiful and awesome souls… and comes highly recommended by me… a dance enthusiast!!!

featured_reviews.name: Viswanath Iyer
featured_reviews.review_text: I was someone who had no dancing background or experience and joined RaSa classes. Sangeeta and Raoul were very supportive and patient with me in making my fundamentals and basics strong which made me grow and experiment as a dancer. I strongly recommend RaSa for learning Salsa and Bachata. Eternally grateful to learn from such wonderful instructors 🙏🙏.

featured_reviews.name: Damayanti Gurtu
featured_reviews.review_text: Sangeeta and Raoul are really patient instructors; they’ll ensure that you learn the steps and don’t hesitate to show them to you several times! They make it a fun, non-intimidating experience to learn salsa. My weekends are definitely a lot better with RaSa!

featured_reviews.name: debaljit nandy
featured_reviews.review_text:
PROFESSIONAL!! FUN & FABULOUS!!
I have been learning salsa for sometime in Mumbai but my association with RASA is very fresh. Now, not only I am enjoying but I am confident about my improvemnent in technique and timing, thanks to Sangeeta and Raoul. Sangeeta is always alert about the slightest mistakes and rectify it with precision. Raoul’s energy and technique with simple demonstration clearly sets up a benchmark for all students. Thus, RASA is defenitely recommended for both advanced and beginners.
!!!Highly recommended for Salsa Lovers!!!

featured_reviews.name: Sarika Bhandare
featured_reviews.review_text: Just loved dancing with Sangeeta and Raul both are very good instructor and dancer.  They have a good patience they will teach u each n every step very precisely. Attended salsa, rueda, bachata class back to back danced for 3 hours continuously and it was super fun, enjoyed a lot.👍Loads of love to u guys  ❤❤ keep dancing.

featured_reviews.name: hetal thakker
featured_reviews.review_text: Sangu is an extremely talented dancer, a friendly teacher and over and above that she is an amazing person, Totally love the vibe of the class.

featured_reviews.name: Niraj Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dont think there is a better experience for me than with RaSa.
Came for a trial class and have stuck around for years now.. worth a shot if you even remotely wanna learn latin dancing

featured_reviews.name: A K
featured_reviews.review_text: Love the vibe of the class and the way Sangeeta teaches! If you're looking to start Salsa/Bachata, this is the place for you.
